notes: Black Friday batch 5 from 5 references the user shared in chat 2026-10-27 (they were not saved as files, so prompts describe the layouts): don't-buy-these, quote + pills (nurse/60% take), email screenshot, secret to happy feet, advertorial alert. Lead offer EITHER 60% OFF SITEWIDE (R48_01, 02, 04) OR buy 2 pairs + free socks and travel bag (R48_03, 05).
